**FINDING #13 (CP-A2b live): local-checks failed because node:20 lacks glob support in `node --test` (needs 21+); fix = node:22 in the fragment + drift-guard should pin the image version**

What: CP-A2b live — `local-checks` failed on BOTH MRs (NOT shallow-clone as first suspected). Root cause: the CI image is node:20, and `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs"` GLOB support landed in Node 21+. On node:20 the glob is not expanded → "Could not find .../brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs" → exit 1.

Fix: pin **node:22** in the GitLab fragment (brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml). Design evaluation (reviewer to rule): (1) global `default: image: node:22` vs per-job `image:` — global default is one place, all 8 jobs inherit (recommended); (2) the DRIFT-GUARD should ASSERT the image version (node:22+) — a consumer who downgrades to node:20 breaks silently, the SAME class as the allow_failure-iff-DETECTION lock. The guard covers everything it guards.

Related — #12 REFINED (decision now evidence-resolved): MR-A's log proved the GitLab LOADER already speaks DIRECT API v4 (fetch + VCS_TOKEN — read the MR body live, ~9s network call, and emitted the message with M1's WIDE closing-keyword vocabulary — the adversarial-review fix visible in production). So the pipeline ALREADY runs the correct pattern; gitlab.mjs `issueView`'s glab dependency is the inconsistency. Option (b) — migrate issueView + all CI-consumed GitLab verbs to direct fetch against CI_API_V4_URL with VCS_TOKEN — is no longer a lean, it is UNIFYING on the proven mechanism (ci-context defaultFetchMr). glab → local interactive only.

RE-RUN mechanics for the runbook (important): a GitLab MR pipeline runs the SOURCE branch tree (refs/merge-requests/N/head), so a retry alone re-runs the OLD fragment. After merging the micro-fix + re-pushing the mirror, the two test/* branches must be UPDATED (merge feature/v2.0.0 into each + push) so the MRs re-evaluate against the corrected tree.

Delivery: micro-fix PR with #12 + #13 together, Part of #231, express. #12's fix rests on the glab-ENOENT diagnosis — CONTINGENT on the MR-B issue-link log: if it confirms ENOENT, nothing changes; if it shows something else, STOP and report before shipping the #12 part. Where: brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml, brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs (issueView), brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context.mjs (defaultFetchMr = the template), ci-context-drift-guard.test.mjs. Related: [[findings/12-gitlab-issueview-glab-ci]].
